integration_issues.issue: BUG FIXED BY TESTING AGENT (data-only): /api/courses/agentic-ai-foundations returned 500 due to Pydantic ValidationError on modules[10].lessons[4].code_sample — the field was stored as a dict {language, code} but the Lesson pydantic model in /app/backend/models.py declares code_sample: Optional[str]. Normalized in both mongo collections (courses + lesson_content_overrides). Endpoint now 200. Root cause is upstream: /app/backend/generate_course_content.py at line 115 and line 177 passes gen.get('code_sample') straight through without coercion, so any LLM response that returns the field as an object propagates the dict.

action_items: HIGH: Harden /app/backend/generate_course_content.py to coerce code_sample dicts to strings. At lines 115 and 177 replace `gen.get('code_sample')` with a guard like `_coerce_code_sample(gen.get('code_sample'))` where the helper extracts `.get('code')` if the value is a dict, else keeps the string, else returns None. Without this the same bug will recur any time the model returns the field as a JSON object.

LOW (from Iter 40 backlog, still outstanding): course seed re-mints lesson UUIDs on every restart; seed_video_quizzes.py should be invoked at startup so the seeded video_checkpoints stay linked. Currently only the manually-applied checkpoints for agentic-ai-foundations survive because they're re-seeded automatically after course seed.
critical_code_review_comments: generate_course_content.py silently trusts LLM-returned schema — every field written from `gen.get(...)` should be normalized/validated (currently only content is dereferenced with .get('content') as a string, others including code_sample and key_takeaways pass through raw).

models.py Lesson.code_sample type is Optional[str] — either enforce with a Pydantic validator that coerces dicts, or widen the type to Union[str, Dict[str,str]] and render both shapes in LessonViewer. Widening feels wrong here (the schema is a doc contract with the frontend); coercing on write is safer.

Landing / CourseCatalog restyle looks well-executed — navy primary buttons, sharp corners (radius 0.25rem), dot-pattern hero, gold accent-rule, ghost numbers all render cleanly, no CLS or z-index regressions observed. CourseCard `max-w-[48%]` truncation of category badge cleanly avoids overlap with Full-curriculum badge on the tightest 3-col grid width.

LessonViewer renders `.prose` markdown from lesson.content, wires Key Takeaways box, code-sample block with a dark IDE-style panel, and inline tutor (Aletheia) with voice controls + 3 quick actions (Explain simply / Real-world example / Quiz me). Composition is clean; no aria/contrast issues seen at the sampled lesson.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: The `Lesson` pydantic model in /app/backend/models.py declares `code_sample: Optional[str] = None`. The FastAPI GET /api/courses/{slug} handler in /app/backend/routers/catalog_router.py line 92 constructs `Course(**doc)` from the Mongo document — Pydantic then validates every nested field. During the Iter-41 LLM content re-generation, generate_course_content.py._ask() returned a lesson JSON object where `code_sample` was itself an object `{"language":"python","code":"# Example: Generating structured audit logs …"}` instead of a bare string. Both enrich_course() (line 177) and generate_full_course() (line 115) pass that value straight through — the update_one writes the dict verbatim to `modules.10.lessons.4.code_sample` and `lesson_content_overrides.code_sample`, breaking the invariant expected by the pydantic model. REPRO: curl /api/courses/agentic-ai-foundations before the fix → 500 with 'string_type input_value=... input_type=dict'. MITIGATION APPLIED: Normalized both the course doc and the lesson_content_overrides doc so `code_sample` is now the string that lives under the dict's `code` key. Endpoint returns 200 and the LessonViewer + video-quiz path both render. PERMANENT FIX (assigned to main agent): add a `_as_code_sample(x)` helper in generate_course_content.py that returns `x.get('code')` when isinstance(x, dict), the string when isinstance(x, str), else None; wire it in at lines 115 and 177 to defend against future LLM schema drift.
